project_name: Sentinel Shift V5.1 — Security Operations Center (SOC) Insider-Threat & Anomaly Workspace
theme: Dark Command Center (Tactical High-Density Cyber SOC)

typography.anti_default_rule: Strictly no Inter for headings. Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk for section titles and JetBrains Mono for metrics, security tokens, timestamps, IP addresses, and telemetry.

hierarchy.label_overline: text-[11px] font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-slate-400 font-semibold

layout_strategy.spacing: Tight to moderate spacing (p-4 to p-6) with high data density. Every card must have internal padding (p-4 or p-5) to prevent text touch with borders.
layout_strategy.container_style: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08) borders with subtle dark backdrop blur, dark slate background (#0F172A), sharp 8px radii (rounded-lg). No glassmorphism refraction over dense data tables.
layout_strategy.header_nav: Fixed top bar z-50 with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#090D14]/90 border-b border-slate-800. Height 64px, with clear live-demo control buttons (Reset Demo, Next Event stepper) and current user risk indicator.

timeline_stepper.description: Chronological horizontal visual event stepper showing Event 1 through N, highlighting Event 6 anomaly transition with custom marker and timestamp comparison.

elements: Severity Counters Grid (Watch, Elevated, High, Critical)

user_selector.description: User profile selector dropdown (Rahul preselected) showing quick risk score badge, primary location, and role.

behavioral_dna_card.description: Side-by-side Baseline Contrast matrix highlighting normal Bengaluru business hours (09:00 - 18:00 IST) vs Event 6 anomalous activity (London, UK at 02:15 AM local) with delta highlight.

score_decomposition.description: 5 Component Score decomposition bars with clear backend availability flags, scores, confidence ratings, active signal family chips: Behavioral Anomaly, Temporal Correlation, Sensitivity Elevation, Novelty, Context Adjustment.

elements: Event ID & Raw Payload viewer with escaped untrusted payload strings
Context Discount Inspector (Applicable vs Expired contexts)

buttons: Dismiss Alert (non-destructive, appends to audit trail)

features: Structured sections: Answer, Key Facts, Uncertainties, Recommended Steps, Event Citations

audit_trail_timeline.description: Appended audit log showing all analyst interactions, note entries, escalation status changes, and backend engine event evaluations.

motion_and_interactions.risk_score_transition: When stepping to Event 6, animate risk score counter smoothly with scale pulse and color glow transition from green/emerald to amber/orange (ELEVATED).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hover states must increase border brightness (border-cyan-500/40) and lift cards slightly (-translate-y-[1px]). Always explicitly define text color on hover (hover:text-white).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Explicit transition rules for transform and opacity only (e.g. transition-transform duration-200 ease-in-out). BANNED: transition: all.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_ratio: APCA high-contrast compliance for dark mode. Primary text #F8FAFC over #0F172A (ratio > 12:1).
accessibility_and_testing.data_testids: MANDATORY on all key interactive elements and metric cards: reset-demo-button, next-event-button, user-select-dropdown, risk-score-display, severity-badge, event-stepper-item, score-component-row, analyst-note-input, escalate-button, dismiss-button, assistant-drawer-toggle, audit-trail-list.
accessibility_and_testing.file_extension_rule: Frontend files are in React .js / .jsx format. Import components appropriately from ./components/ui/.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure backend API calls map cleanly to the FastAPI endpoints or handle offline fallback gracefully if backend is initialising.
Verify Event 6 compound anomaly triggers the ELEVATED risk state transition with full score component breakdown.
Display all 5 component score bars with explicit availability tags provided by the backend.
Format untrusted payload strings safely in Evidence Provenance viewer.
Utilize lucide-react icons for security telemetry icons (Shield, AlertTriangle, Terminal, Activity, Compass, Lock, Zap, FileText, User, MapPin, Clock).
Include Sonner toast notifications for analyst actions (Add Note, Escalate, Dismiss).
Add responsive side drawers and responsive tabs so the SOC workspace looks pristine at 1280px, 1536px, and mobile viewports.
